description: Create an invoice for a client and get its pay link. Give an amount or line items. Needs an access token with mcp:invoices:write. Moves no money.

accessToken.description: Your Studio access token (sgl_pat_*). Can be omitted when the connection sends Authorization: Bearer sgl_pat_*

amount.description: Total in USDC. Optional when line_items are given

chains.description: Pay to your verified wallets on these chains. Default: all you have

expiry_days.description: Days the pay link stays open. Default 7

line_items.description: Optional. The total is their sum and they are listed on the invoice

payment_options.description: Optional payout wallets instead of your verified ones. Addresses are used exactly as given

name: create_invoice
